note: Adversarial and ordinary scenarios required by the preparation brief that the canon states qualitatively or not at all. Every expectation here is computed by applying frozen canonical formulas (Theil-Sen, ALK-SLOPE-UNCERTAINTY-001, ALK-SUPPORTED-SLOPE-001, ALK-STEP-CAP-001, ALK-046, ALK-ROUNDING-001, ALK-RESPONSE-CLASSIFIER-001) to the stated inputs. No expectation is derived from V1 runtime behaviour (DEC-013).
